item.title: ‘Sinners’ Production Designer Hannah Beachler Slams BAFTAs “Throw Away Apology” Following Racial Slur Outburst
item.description: Last night, during the BAFTAs broadcast, an ugly and regrettable moment stunned audiences in the room and at home. As “Sinners” stars Michael B. Jordan and Delroy Lindo presented an award, John Davidson, a Tourette’s advocate and the subject of the film “I Swear,” suddenly shouted the n-word. Davidson’s Tourette’s includes coprolalia, which can involve involuntary verbal tics, including racial slurs. item.description: It may have taken much longer than many believed was appropriate, but both BAFTA and John Davidson have now formally apologized for the racially charged incident that occurred during the 2026 BAFTA Awards ceremony. As “Sinners” stars Delroy Lindo and Michael B. Jordan presented the award for Special Visual Effects, Davidson shouted out the “n” word. item.title: Tom Hanks Set To Play Abraham Lincoln In Live Action/Stop Motion Hybrid For ‘Anomalisa’ Director Duke Johnson
